_comment: Curated index of best-practice, protocol and tutorial literature for electrochemistry. Each section is scoped either 'domain' (interfacial electrochemistry and electrocatalysis) or 'general' (cross-domain literature on reporting, data and reproducibility that the field builds on). Tags in the 'topic' group are section slugs and cross-list a work into further sections; the other tag groups are descriptive. A work is stored exactly once. See README.md.
